title: Get help with Hunter Water bills
summary: Hunter Water customers can request payment assistance and find support options for managing their bills.
intro:
Hunter Water customers who need help with their bills can request payment assistance.

Short and long-term support options are available for home owners and tenants, including:

You can speak with the Hunter Water customer care team on 1300 657 657.

faqs.q: How can I get help with my Hunter Water bills?
faqs.a: You can request payment assistance and speak with the Hunter Water customer care team on 1300 657 657.

faqs.q: What types of support are available?
faqs.a: Short and long-term support options are available for both home owners and tenants.
